sql_templates.description: SQL to fetch latest VCP breakout candidates with strong fundamentals.
sql_templates.sql:
WITH latest_stage_snapshots AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
), latest_vcp_picks AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks)
    ORDER BY vcp_score DESC, rank ASC
    LIMIT 10
)
SELECT ev.symbol, ev.close, ev.volume, ss.enhanced_fund_score, ss.trading_signal
FROM market.equity_eod ev
JOIN latest_stage_snapshots ss ON ev.symbol = ss.symbol
JOIN latest_vcp_picks vp ON ev.symbol = vp.symbol
WHERE ev.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market.equity_eod)
  AND ss.stage = 'STAGE_2'
  AND ss.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
ORDER BY ss.enhanced_fund_score DESC
LIMIT 10;

title: VCP Breakouts With Fundamentals Variant 0170
